4//! Common filter helper functions.
5//!
6//! Unlike the filters defines in [`crate::third_party::vello_common::filter_effects`], the filters in this module
7//! represent a special representation of each filter to be used as the basis for rendering in
8//! `vello_hybrid` and `vello_cpu`.
9
10use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::drop_shadow::{DropShadow, transform_shadow_params};
11use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::flood::Flood;
12use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::gaussian_blur::{GaussianBlur, transform_blur_params};
13use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::offset::Offset;
14use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter_effects::{Filter, FilterPrimitive};
15use crate::third_party::vello_common::kurbo::{Affine, Vec2};

22/// A filter that has been prepared for rendering.
23#[derive(Debug)]
24pub enum PreparedFilter {
25    /// A flood filter.
26    Flood(Flood),
27    /// A gaussian blur filter.
28    GaussianBlur(GaussianBlur),
29    /// An offset filter.
30    Offset(Offset),
31    /// A drop shadow filter.
32    DropShadow(DropShadow),
33}
34
35impl PreparedFilter {
36    /// Build a new prepared filter for the given transform.
37    pub fn new(filter: &Filter, transform: &Affine) -> Self {
38        // Multi-primitive filter graphs are not yet implemented.
39        if filter.graph.primitives.len() != 1 {
40            unimplemented!("Multi-primitive filter graphs are not yet supported");
41        }
42
43        match &filter.graph.primitives[0] {
44            FilterPrimitive::Flood { color } => {
45                let flood = Flood::new(*color);
46                Self::Flood(flood)
47            }
48            FilterPrimitive::GaussianBlur { std_deviation, edge_mode } => {
49                let scaled_std_dev = transform_blur_params(*std_deviation, transform);
50                let blur = GaussianBlur::new(scaled_std_dev, *edge_mode);
51                Self::GaussianBlur(blur)
52            }
53            FilterPrimitive::DropShadow { dx, dy, std_deviation, color, edge_mode } => {
54                let (scaled_dx, scaled_dy, scaled_std_dev) = transform_shadow_params(*dx, *dy, *std_deviation, transform);
55                let drop_shadow = DropShadow::new(scaled_dx, scaled_dy, scaled_std_dev, *edge_mode, *color);
56
57                Self::DropShadow(drop_shadow)
58            }
59            FilterPrimitive::Offset { dx, dy } => {
60                let (scaled_dx, scaled_dy) = transform_offset_params(*dx, *dy, transform);
61                let offset = Offset::new(scaled_dx, scaled_dy);
62
63                Self::Offset(offset)
64            }
65            _ => {
66                // Other primitives like Blend, ColorMatrix, ComponentTransfer, etc.
67                // are not yet implemented
68                unimplemented!("Other filter primitives not yet implemented");
69            }
70        }
71    }
72}
73
74/// Transform an offset's dx/dy using the affine transformation's linear part.
75///
76/// # Returns
77/// A tuple of (`scaled_dx`, `scaled_dy`) in device space.
78fn transform_offset_params(dx: f32, dy: f32, transform: &Affine) -> (f32, f32) {
79    let offset = Vec2::new(dx as f64, dy as f64);
80    let [a, b, c, d, _, _] = transform.as_coeffs();
81    let transformed_offset = Vec2::new(a * offset.x + c * offset.y, b * offset.x + d * offset.y);
82    (transformed_offset.x as f32, transformed_offset.y as f32)
83}
